name: Vote Instruction Request
definition: Decision of the voting party for one resolution. Several types of decisions can be indicated to allow for split vote specification.

Discretionary.name: Discretionary
Discretionary.definition: Number of votes for which decision is left to the party that will exercise the voting right.

GlobalVoteInstruction.name: Global Vote Instruction
GlobalVoteInstruction.definition: Vote instruction per resolution is cast for the entire entitlement.

VoteForMeetingResolution.name: Vote For Meeting Resolution
VoteForMeetingResolution.definition: Specifies the vote recommendation for resolutions added during the meeting.

VoteExecutionConfirmation.name: Vote Execution Confirmation
VoteExecutionConfirmation.definition: Indicates that a Vote execution confirmation is requested.

MeetingInstruction.name: Meeting Instruction
MeetingInstruction.definition: Meeting instruction which contains a vote instruction.

VotePerResolution.name: Vote Per Resolution
VotePerResolution.definition: Specifies the number of votes to be cast for a specific resolution.

RelatedProxyAppointment.name: Related Proxy Appointment
RelatedProxyAppointment.definition: Proxy appointment to which instructions are attached.
